# Project-local Linux dependencies

These files allow Visual Live System to build and run without installing
additional system packages. They were downloaded on 2026-08-26 from the
official CachyOS package mirror and the official Un4seen site.

Included versions:

- RtAudio 6.0.1-4.1 (CachyOS x86-64-v4 package)
- PortMidi 2.0.8-1.1 (CachyOS x86-64-v4 package)
- BASS 2.4.18.3 (official Linux x86_64 archive)
- BASSFLAC 2.4.6.1 (official Linux x86_64 archive)

The corresponding licence texts are under `licenses/`. BASS and BASSFLAC are
not open-source libraries; review Un4seen's current licensing terms before
redistributing or using the application commercially.
